profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Capital One | AI-Assisted Engineering & Agentic Developer Tooling (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) | Backend & Distributed Systems | AWS · GCP · Kubernetes | Ph.D. ECE
profile.summary: I build backend systems in regulated industries and make engineering teams faster with AI. At Capital One, I've led team-wide adoption of AI-assisted development - building custom Claude Code skills that automate code quality and testing - while shipping customer-facing systems on AWS.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built custom Claude Code skills and rules that automate SonarQube code-quality analysis, linting, and unit test generation across daily development.
 • Led team-wide adoption of AI-assisted development workflows (Claude Code, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot): defined standards for validating AI-generated code — saving 2+ weeks of collective development time.
 • Re-architected customer-facing Credit Card Fulfillment tooling end-to-end (Vue.js/TypeScript frontend, AWS serverless backend), cutting workflow timelines by 50%.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description: Skills: Debugging · Programming · Agile Methodologies · Python (Programming Language)
